messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — AWS Marketplace listing for our SI partner needs a SOC2 summary + high-level pen-test findings by EOD Thu. Partner legal asked for a one-page artifact they can attach to the listing.

maria: Ack. Do we have an owner for redaction + presigned link for artifacts?

dan: I can own putting together the one-pager with the SOC2 scope and high-level results. Need someone to scrub PII from reports.

priya: I can handle redaction. Can you send me the raw artifacts? Prefer presigned S3 links with 7d expiry.

alex: @priya great. @dan please drop the baseline files in the compliance bucket under partners/si-acme/raw/. Use this naming: `si-acme_soc2_YYYYMMDD.zip` and `si-acme_pen_summary.txt`.

maria: Also we need the vendor questionnaire answers (security questionnaire) — the partner filled an earlier draft but it references internal-only docs. We should produce a sanitized copy.

dan: I'll extract the Q&A into a sanitized doc. What level of detail do we want for pen test findings? high-level vuln classes + remediation status?

priya: Yes — high-level only. No exploit code, no IP addresses, no tester PII. Example bullets: "No critical vulns in infra; 2 medium findings remediated; webapp XSS fixed".

alex: Compliance ask: include attestation line from Engineering lead (+ date). Maria — can you route to legal for a short NDA-friendly blurb?

maria: On it. I'll ping legal and ask for a one-sentence attestation template we can reuse for marketplace artifacts.

compliance-bot: Reminder: marketplace artifacts must be stored in `s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts/partners/si-acme/` and marked with tag `marketplace:true`. Presigned links should expire <= 14 days.

priya: Good call. I'll move redacted files to the marketplace bucket and add tags. Will set presigned links to 7 days.

alex: Timeline check: Dan to drop raw by tomorrow morning, Priya to deliver redacted + presigned links by Wed EOD, Maria to get legal blurb by Wed, then we assemble final one-pager Thu morning and send to partner.

dan: Raw upload planned for 09:00 UTC tomorrow.

priya: Redaction ETA Wed 18:00 UTC.

maria: Legal should turn the template around Wed 12:00 UTC.

alex: Awesome. Last items — please include a short change-log file (`artifact_manifest.md`) listing what was removed/redacted and who approved. That stays internal but we attach a one-line "redaction performed" statement in the public one-pager.

dan: Will add `artifact_manifest.md` to raw set.

priya: Quick Q: do we need to run a fresh vuln scan (Auth0/compliance requested) or is last month's scan OK?

maria: For marketplace they prefer "within 90 days". Last scan was 60 days ago so we are good, but call that out in the one-pager.

alex: Perfect. If anything blocks presigned uploads ping me directly. :thumbsup:

priya: uploading raw now (done). Link: <s3-presigned-placeholder> — will re-upload redacted to marketplace bucket when ready.

dan: Confirmed receipt. Starting extraction and summary now.

maria: Legal replied with attestation template: "I attest that the attached artifacts have been redacted to remove confidential info and are suitable for marketplace disclosure." They want sign-off from Eng lead + security.

alex: I'll coordinate sign-offs. Thanks team.

compliance-bot: Action items created: owner=dan task=prepare-one-pager due=Thu; owner=priya task=redact+upload due=Wed; owner=maria task=legal-attestation due=Wed.
